item.description: European governments race to turn defense spending pledges into military capability, boosting companies' order books.

item.description: Elon Musk, a critic of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, had ordered the slowdown of SpaceX's Starlink, The Wall Street Journal previously reported.

item.title: SpaceX records $561 million investment gain from stake in Elon Musk's Boring Co.

item.title: Trump's approval rating on economy hits all-time low as midterm looms: CNBC survey

item.title: SpaceX and Tesla have high election stakes as Elon Musk pours $366 million into campaigns
item.description: Musk’s biggest political bet is on the Senate, where control could shape future investigations, federal spending and regulations affecting SpaceX and Tesla.

item.title: Disney’s multiplatform Super Bowl plan frustrates ABC affiliates

item.title: Japan core inflation in September surges to its highest this year at 2.1%
